text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've been giving great guidance all this 
time. Your focal points are spot-on.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So as a special privilege, I'll grant you 
the right to give me advice. Go on, keep 
it useful and wrap it up in one minute, 
okay?
choice_data_list:
We're in the middle of training too, 
though...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's not every day you get the chance 
to debate with King, you know!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To let an opportunity like that slip 
away... Don't you think that's utterly 
unacceptable?

It looks like she won't let me go until I 
give her some advice. In that case――
choice_data_list: Talk about the timing to make a move.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Not bad. That proposal certainly 
piques my interest.

And then, I talked with King Halo for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...My, not a bad perspective. When it 
comes to tactical maneuvers, it's all 
about late-race burst!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And my weapon is also my late-stage burst! 
Now, let us speak our minds to one 
another!

And then, I talked with King Halo for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is it that time already? Well then, 
I shall take my leave.
